performed: Read all manifest entries and local archive paths.
Recomputed SHA-256 for every archived Markdown document and compared it with manifest.hash.
Checked rawOriginalPath presence for every entry.
Reviewed sourceFormat and conversion notes for whether local originals can independently prove exact official text.
Summarized currentness/effective-status readiness from manifest currentness fields only.
method.passCriteria: Exact text can be marked passed only when committed evidence proves the archived Markdown text was independently compared against the official source/original with a reproducible method strong enough to catch omissions, additions, ordering changes, and lossy conversion artifacts.
method.limitation: The current repository has local hashes and raw/original evidence, but does not have a whole-archive reproducible exact-text comparison artifact. HTML entries require a content-scope extractor/comparison against independent official captures; PDF entries require page/text extraction evidence strong enough to overcome lossy conversion limits.

conclusion.finalReleaseImpact: Final source-reader release cannot be declared complete while exactTextValidation remains pending/blocked for all manifest entries, unless Architect/user accepts a narrowed non-final release status.
